scope: SPEC-061 T001 owner review of the activity viewer specification (VIS.1): spec.md with requirements REQ-001 to REQ-015, the requested decisions D1–D6 as amended by the 2026-10-31 adversarial and counterfactual reviews, the UI, security and privacy contract and its never-collect deviation table, the loom event schema, the effort evidence pack contract, the surfaces matrix, plan.md with deliveries VIS.1a and VIS.1b and the T035 go/no-go checkpoint, tasks.md, validation-plan.md, tracks.md (T006) and host-verification-runbook.md (T007). Decisions: D1–D6 confirmed; OD-3 keep the command agent-braid view and the working name Loom, public name decided before VIS.1 release notes; OD-5 WebGL2 only; OD-6 OS-assigned port with optional --port; OD-7 the six never-collect deviations accepted as listed; OD-8 checkpoint T035 by 2027-01-31 and census threshold of at least 5 sessions or run directories of the last four weeks with at least one coordination artifact and at least 3 of the 6 artifact kinds overall. Milestones: VIS.1 (#25) is the only implementation milestone; SPEC-062 to SPEC-064 and their milestones are written only after T035 records keep for the track, and probe receipts T030–T033 add their findings to tracks.md meanwhile.

the VIS.1b scope, which depends on the T035 checkpoint decision

limits: Acceptance binds the frozen authority and evidence commit only; later changes to the specification, the contracts or the open decisions need a new review. ADR 0032 and ADR 0033 were accepted separately on 2026-11-01. Acceptance is distinct from implementation, integration and release.
